recipes.name: Baked Hawaiian Sandwiches
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 400° and place a rack on the lower half of the oven. Place a half slice of ham, cheeses, and turkey on the bottom of each roll. Stir together butter, sugar, onion flakes, poppy seeds, and honey mustard. Brush over the top of each sandwich. Bake for 15 min. or until tops are golden brown and fillings are hot. Personal Note: Use parchment paper. Don’t need onion flakes and poppy seeds.

recipes.name: Buffalo Chicken Dip
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees and grease 9″ pie dish. In a large bowl, add chicken, cream cheese, wing sauce and 1/2 cup of each of the cheeses. Combine. Turn mixture out into prepared pie dish, smoothing top lightly with a spatula. Top with remaining cheese. Bake 30-35 minutes, or until lightly browned and bubbly. Serve immediately with tortilla chips or crackers.

recipes.name: Bean Dip
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: Layer in this order.

recipes.name: Brown Sugar Smokies
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350° Cut bacon into thirds. Cover (dip) bacon into brown sugar. Roll one sausage in each piece of bacon. Arrange on foil lined baking pan. Sprinkle a lot of brown sugar over top. Bake for 20 min. Pit on chafing dish or slow cooker to keep warm.

recipes.name: Cherry Punch
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 6 oz. can Frozen Lemonade Concentrate, thawed
6 oz. can Frozen Limeade Concentrate, thawed
recipes.directions: In a blender, combine concentrates and pineapple; cover and blend until smooth. Pour into a gallon- size container; stir in water. Store in the refrigerator. To serve, pour the mixture into a punch bowl; add cherry soda and ginger ale. Garnish with lemon and lime slices if desired. Yield: about 6 quarts

recipes.name: Mushroom Cheese Stromboli
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350°  In skillet sauté mushrooms in butter.  Set aside.  On lightly floured board roll dough into 30x8 in. rectangle.  Cut in half length wise (16x8 in. pieces)  On long side of each piece layer pepperoni, cheeses, mushrooms, sauce, oregano, and garlic powder.  Fold over dough and pinch to seal.  Combine egg and water.  Brush over edges and top of dough.  With sharp knife cut 5 small steam vents in the top of each loaf.  Place on greased baking sheets.  Bake for 27-30 min.

recipes.name: Party Pinwheels
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: ½ cup Red Bell Pepper, diced
recipes.directions: In a mixing bowl combine cream cheese, ranch dressing mix, and green onions.  Spread mixture onto each tortilla.  Sprinkle red pepper, celery, olives, and cheese over the cream cheese mixture.  Roll up tortillas, then wrap tightly in foil.  Chill 2 hours or overnight.  Slice into 1 in. slices. (6-7 slices per shell)

recipes.name: Sweet Sausage Rolls
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 400°  Unroll crescent dough and separate into triangles.  Cut each length wise into 3 triangles.  Roll a sausage in each and set aside.  Combine remaining ingredients in 11 by 7 inch pan.  Arrange sausage rolls, seam side down, in butter mixture.  Bake uncovered for 15-20 min.

recipes.name: Vegetable Pizza
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: Bake crescent rolls (seal perforated edges) according to package on 9x13 in. pan or 15x10x1 in. pan.  Mix mayo, cream cheese, and ranch.  Put on cooled crust.  Chop the vegetables and cheese.  Put on top.

recipes.name: Pimiento Cheese Dip
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 375°  Combine cream cheese and mayo. Add in pimientos, green onions, ground mustard, Worcestershire sauce, and a dash of hot sauce.  Add in shredded cheese.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Spread mixture into a 2 quart baking dish prepared with nonstick spray.

recipes.name: Simmered Smoke Links
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 2 16 oz. packages Mini Smoked Sausage Links
recipes.directions: Place sausages in slow cooker.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Pour over sausages. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours. Yield: 16-20 servings

recipes.name: Velveeta Cheese Dip
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 1 can Rotel Diced Tomatoes and Green Chilies, drained
recipes.directions: Mix all ingredients in a microwave safe bowl.  Microwave on high for 6-7 min. or until cheese is melted.  Stir every 3 min.  Serve with tortilla chips or cut up vegetables.

recipes.name: Flank Steak
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 2/3 cup V8 Juice or Vegetable Juice
recipes.directions: Mix all ingredients.  Put in Ziploc bag to marinate.  Refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight.  Grill steak covered over medium-high heat for 6-10 minutes on each side or until done.

recipes.name: Macaroni Bake
recipes.author: Ann Phillips
ingredients: 2 ½ cups Macaroni, cooked for 10 minutes and drained
1 Chicken Bouillon Cube, dissolved in 1 can of water
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350° Brown ground beef and drain. Sauté vegetables in margarine.  Add remaining ingredients except cheese.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Bake for 1 hour.

recipes.name: Meatloaf
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 1 cup Dried Bread or Cracker Crumbs
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350° In a large bowl, combine the beef, egg, onion, milk, and bread crumbs or cracker crumbs.  Season with salt and pepper to taste and place in a lightly greased 5 by 9 inch loaf pan, or form into a loaf and place in a lightly greased 9 by 13 inch baking dish.  In a separate small bowl, combine the brown sugar, mustard, and ketchup.  Mix well and pour over the meatloaf.  Bake for 1 hour. Editor’s Note: Double the ketchup mixture.  Sauté onions in butter before adding to meat.

recipes.name: Sloppy Joes
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: ¼ cup Green Bell Pepper, chopped
recipes.directions: In a medium skillet over medium heat, brown the ground beef, onion, and green pepper; drain off liquids.  Stir in the garlic powder, mustard, ketchup, and brown sugar; mix thoroughly.  Reduce heat, and simmer for 30 minutes.  Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Mongolian Beef
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Slice the steak in ¼-inch slices. Lay the slices flat, and use a meat pounder to flatten the meat. Put the meat in a ziploc bag and coat in the cornstarch. Pour the canola oil into a large frying pan, and heat on medium high heat. Add the steak to the pan in a single layer and cook for 30 seconds per side. Set steak aside, then sprinkle with salt. Next, add the ginger, garlic, and red pepper flakes (if desired for more spice) to the pan and sauté for 10-15 seconds. Stir in soy sauce, water, and brown sugar and bring the mixture to a boil. Fold the steak back in and let the sauce thicken for 20-30 seconds. (The cornstarch used on the steak should thicken the sauce.) Turn off the heat, add the green onions, and stir to combine. Serve over white rice, rice noodles or in lettuce wraps.

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Ground Beef and Broccoli
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Prepare the Sauce: In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, ginger, red pepper flakes, and cornstarch slurry. Cook the Ground Beef: Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté the onion for 2 minutes, then add ground beef. Cook until browned. Stir in garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Stir in the broccoli and add ¼ cup water. Cover and steam for 3-4 minutes until tender but crisp. Pour the Sauce: Stir in the honey garlic sauce and let simmer for 2 minutes.

recipes.name: Burgers
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: ½ cup crushed saltine crackers or Panko breadcrumbs
recipes.directions: Mix it all together. For thick patties, grill 3-4 min per side, 2 for thin patties.

recipes.name: Banana Nut Bread
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter , softened to room temperature
4 very ripe bananas , mashed with a fork or potato masher
2 tablespoon unsalted butter , slightly softened and cut into pieces
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees F. Grease and flour a 9x5 inch loaf pan. Set aside. For the streusel topping, add the flour, brown sugar, and cinnamon in a medium bowl and mix until combined. Cut in the butter using a pastry blender, until it resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in chopped walnuts. Set aside. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg. Set aside. Cream the butter and sugars in a large mixing bowl until light and fluffy. Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well in between each addition. With a wooden spoon, stir in the mashed bananas, buttermilk and vanilla. Slowly stir in the dry ingredients. Once the flour is incorporated, stop right there. Do NOT over stir. Gently stir in walnuts. The batter will be thick. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan. Sprinkle the streusel topping evenly over the batter. Bake the bread for 1 hour to 1 hour 10 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the loaf comes out clean. Remove from oven and cool 10-15 minutes in the pan on a wire rack. Remove the bread from the pan and continue to cool on the wire rack. Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.name: Red Lobster Biscuits
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: 1 ⅓ cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Mix flour, cheddar cheese, baking powder, garlic powder, salt, and parsley. In a separate bowl, mix milk, egg, and butter. Pour into dry ingredients. Mix until a sticky dough forms, being careful not to overmix it. If the dough is dry, add a splash of milk. Divide dough into 8-10 mounds on prepared baking sheet, about 2 inches apart. Bake for 12-14 minutes. Brush each biscuit with topping and return to oven for an additional 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Potica Nut Roll
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: In large bowl, dissolve yeast in water.  Add milk, sugar, margarine, salt, egg, and 1½ cups flour.  Beat until smooth with mixer.  Gradually add enough remaining flour to form a soft dough.  Use a spatula to beat.  Turn onto a floured surface; knead until smooth and elastic.  Place dough in a greased bowl,turning once to grease top. Cover with towel and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour.  Filling:Combine margarine, brown sugar, eggs, vanilla, and nuts.  Add milk until mixture is of spreading consistency, about ½ cup; set aside. Punch dough down and separate into 2 rolls.  Roll to 14 by 18 inch size.  Spread filling to within 1 inch of edges.   Roll up from long sides.  Pinch ends and seams to seal.  Place on greased cookie sheet.  Brush with egg and water mixture before baking.  Bake at 350° for 30-35 minutes.  Brush with melted margarine after baking.  Cool on wire rack.  Wrap in foil and put in zip-lock freezer bag to freeze. IF Raising Dough in Oven: Heat at lowest setting (170°) for 2 minutes.  Turn oven off.  Place a pan of very warm water toward back of oven.  Place covered bowl on center rack.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Bread
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350°  Grease and flour three 9x5 in. loaf pans.  IN a large bowl, mix together the pumpkin, oil, sugar, and eggs.   Combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves; stir into the pumpkin mixture until well blended.  Divide the batter evenly between the prepared pans.  Bake for 1 hour 5 min.  The top of loaf should spring back when lightly pressed.  Variations:  Add raisins, pecans, or walnuts instead of chocolate chips.

recipes.name: Breakfast Strata
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 1 tsp. Salt and Several Grinds of Pepper
½ cup Thinly Sliced Green Onions
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 325° Sauté mushrooms in oil.  Season with salt and set aside.  Whisk half and half, eggs, salt, and pepper until smooth.  Spray a 9 by 13 inch Pyrex or ceramic baking dish with vegetable cooking spray.  Line bottom with 6 slices of bread.  Scatter half of the ham, and half of the mushrooms over the bread, then sprinkle with half of the scallions and cheese.  Pour 1 cup of egg mixture over the top.  Repeat layers with remaining bread, ham, mushrooms, cheese, and scallions.  Slowly pour remaining egg mixture evenly over top.  Cover with plastic wrap, then weight down casserole with 3 16 ounce cans for at least 15 minutes to submerge ingredients. (Can be refrigerated overnight, but return to room temperature before baking)  Adjust oven rack to middle position.  Bake until custard is just set, about 50 minutes.  Turn on broiler and broil until strata is spotty brown and puffy (watch carefully), about 5 minutes longer.  Let stand for 8 to 10 minutes, then serve immediately. Personal Note: Sauté vegetables.  Cut crusts off of bread. Possible combinations: sausage and mushrooms, or peppers and onion

recipes.name: Crescent Roll Quiche
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: 1 cup shredded Swiss or cheddar cheese
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350. Beat eggs in bowl and add everything. Spread crescent roll over the bottom of a 9x13 inch pan. Pour egg mixture over top. Bake about 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Air Fryer Chicken Thighs
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Place chicken in single layer in air fryer. Bake at 380 for 15 minutes, turning halfway

recipes.name: Crockpot Creamy Ranch Chicken Sandwiches
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Place all ingredients in a crock pot, except green onions and bacon bits. Cook on high for 3 hours and shred.

recipes.name: Crock Pot Mexican Chicken
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 4 oz. can mild diced green chilies
recipes.directions: Rub chicken breasts with oil and place in the bottom of your slow cooker. Add all of the remaining ingredients. Cook on high for 2-4 hours or on low for 6-7 hours or until chicken is tender enough to shred. Shred the chicken and let it cook on low for an additional 20 minutes to absorb some of the liquid/juices. Drain all excess liquid. Taste and add hot sauce to taste if desired. If serving over rice, try stirring in some enchilada sauce after you drain your chicken for some saucy Enchilada Mexican Chicken.

recipes.name: Baked Chicken Burritos
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions:
Prepare Mexican Chicken according to recipe directions. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Line a baking sheet with foil and add a baking rack on top. Prepare burritos by adding a heaping ½ cup filling to each tortilla, top with desired amount of cheese and roll up burrito style. Place burritos on the baking rack and brush both sides lightly with olive oil or spray with nonstick cooking spray. Cook for 18-20 minutes or until golden. Broil to desired crispiness, flip over and broil the other side until golden. 
 Meanwhile, prepare sauce by melting butter in olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook, stirring constantly for 3 minutes. Reduce heat to low then gradually whisk in chicken broth. Add spices and bring to a simmer while stirring until thickened, about 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in green chilies, cheese until melted, then sour cream. Add hot sauce to taste (optional). To serve, top burritos Cheesy Green Chili Sour Cream Sauce and desired toppings.

recipes.name: Southwest Chicken Wrap
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: .75 lb chicken breasts, boneless and skinless
¼ cup lime juice , about one lime
1 tsp olive oil , to sauté the veggies
¾ cup thawed or fresh corn kernels
1 cup black beans, drained and rinsed
¼ cup cotija cheese or cheddar cheese
½-1 Tbsp chipotle peppers in adobo
1-2 Tbsp water, *to thin the crema a bit
recipes.directions: Cut chicken into small bite-sized pieces. Marinate with chicken ingredients for 15min - 24 hrs. Combine all crema ingredients. You can use a blender to combine if you like. Saute the chicken and set aside. Saute the pepper and onion. Add in garlic. Add the chicken back in to bring it back to temperature. Make and wrap burritos. In a skillet, heat butter and brown burritos on both sides.

recipes.name: Honey Soy Chicken Marinade
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: 1/4 cup Chinese cooking wine or dry sherry (sub chicken broth)
recipes.directions: For the marinade, combine all ingredients. You may garnish chicken with green onions. For the serving sauce, place reserved sauce in a small saucepan. Mix cornflour and water, then add into saucepan. Simmer over medium for 5 minutes, stirring regularly, until it thickens to a syrupy consistency.

recipes.name: Do It All Marinade
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Use as a marinade for beef, pork, chicken, or shrimp.

recipes.name: Cheesy Chicken
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 375° Mix all ingredients.  Dip and coat chicken.  Bake for 35-40 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: 1 can Condensed Cream of Chicken Soup
4 cups Cooked, Cubed Chicken(about 4 chicken breasts)
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350° Spread refried beans on each tortilla. Combine soup and sour cream. Stir in chicken. Spoon 1/3 - ½ cup down on the center of each tortilla. Top with 1 tbsp. of cheese. Roll up and place seam side down in greased 9 by 13 inch pan. (you need 2 pans) Pour enchilada sauce over top. Sprinkle with remaining cheese, onions, and olives. Bake uncovered for 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: Panko with White Italian Bread Crumbs
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 450° or 375°spice Beat Eggs.  Dip chicken in flour then eggs and crumbs.  Let stand for 15 minutes.  Heat oil and cook chicken for about 2 minutes a side or until golden.  Place chicken in baking dish.  Top with sauce.  Drizzle with olive oil.  About 15 minutes before done top with mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  Bake for about 25 minutes at 450° and 30 minutes at 375°

recipes.name: Butter Chicken
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 1 cup Crushed Buttery Round Cracker Crumbs
¼ cup Butter, cut into pieces
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 375°  Place eggs and cracker crumbs in two separate shallow bowls.  Mix cracker crumbs with garlic powder, pepper, Italian seasoning, and salt.  Dip the chicken in the eggs, then dredge in the crumb mixture to coat.  Arrange coated chicken in a 9 by 13 inch baking dish.  Place pieces of butter around the chicken.  Bake for 30 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear.  Flip once ½ way through.

recipes.name: Honey Mustard Mozzarella Chicken
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 375° Place the chicken breast halves in a baking dish, and drizzle evenly with honey and mustard.  Sprinkle with lemon pepper. Wrap 2 pieces of bacon around each piece of chicken. Bake the chicken for 30-35 minutes. Then add cheese and broil chicken on each side a few minutes to crisp bacon.

recipes.name: Spicy Citrus Chicken Skewers
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 1 Envelope of Good Seasons Italian Salad Dressing Mix
1 ¼ pound Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breasts, cut lengthwise into 20 strips
recipes.directions: Mix honey, juice, salad dressing mix, and hot pepper sauce in large bowl.  Reserve ¼ cup of the honey mixture. Marinate for at least 1 hour. Thread chicken onto soaked skewers. Place on rack of broiler pan. Broil 4 inches from heat 8-10 minutes or until chicken is cooked through, turning and brushing occasionally with reserved ¼ cup honey mixture.

recipes.name: Mini Chicken Pot Pies
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 375. Thaw frozen veggies. Combine cream of chicken soup, sour cream, poulty seasoning, salt, and pepper. Add in chicken and veggies, and sprinkle in some cheese. Spray muffin pan or ramekins. Line with crescent rolls (you can pinch rolls together and cut the size crescent square you want. Use a cookie scoop to fill evenly. Cook for about 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Disney Grilled Cheese
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: In one bowl, combine cream cheese, cheddar, heavy cream, and salt.  Spread on inside of bread slices.  In second bowl, combine mayo, garlic, and salt.  Spread on outside of bread slices.  Grill as normal, using 4 slices of cheese per sandwich, 2 provolone and 2 american.

recipes.name: Egg Salad Sandwiches
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: In a bowl, gently mix the eggs, mayonnaise, onion, salt, mustard powder, garlic powder, pepper, and dill.  Cover and refrigerate 8 hours, or overnight.  To serve, spread equal amounts on 4 slices.  Top with remaining bread.

recipes.name: Spiral Stromboli
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 375°  Unroll dough and pat into a 14 by 12 inch rectangle.  Spread cheese to within ½ inch of the edge.  Top with meat and pimientos.  Roll up jelly style, starting with the short side.  Seal seam and tuck ends under.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: 8-16 ounces sliced white mushrooms or baby bella mushrooms
recipes.directions: Warm 2 tablespoons butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Stir in mushrooms and cook until soft, approximately 3 minutes. Remove mushrooms and their liquid, and set aside. Pour stock into saucepan and bring to boil, then reduce to low simmer. In another saucepan, melt 4 tablespoons butter until foaming. Add onions and garlic. Cook only until onions are softened, not browned. Add white wine if using and give time for alcohol to cook off. Add rice. Stir until a few grains start to pop. Add broth, a few ladles of stock, salt, and pepper. Stir over low heat until liquid has been absorbed. Continue adding stock a few ladles at a time, letting the rice absorb the liquid before adding more. Stir constantly. After approximately 20 to 25 minutes, rice should be just tender and risotto thick and creamy. Remove saucepan from heat. Add parmesan cheese and remaining 1 tablespoon butter. Mix until butter has melted. Stir in mushrooms. Season with more salt, if necessary.

recipes.name: Eggplant Parmigiana
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: ½ cup Italian Dry Bread Crumbs
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350°  For the sauce: In oil in large skillet, sauté onion and garlic. Add tomatoes, paste, oregano,basil, salt, pepper, and sugar. Bring to a boil and simmer for 45 minutes, covered. Breading Eggplant: Remove skin! Lay eggplant on paper towels to absorb excess liquid. In pie plate, combine eggs and 1 tbsp. of water. Mix well with fork. Combine bread crumbs and 1/2 cup of Parmesan cheese. Dip eggplant into egg mixture in crumb mixture. In oil in skillet sauté eggplant until golden brown and crisp on both sides. Add oil as needed. In 13 by 9 inch greased pan,arrange half of the eggplant on the bottom. Sprinkle parmesan and top with mozzarella cheese. Cover with half of tomato sauce. Arrange remaining eggplant over sauce. Top with remaining sauce and cheese. Sprinkle withParmesan. Bake uncovered for 20-25 minutes. To serve frozen: Bake frozen ate 350 covered for 45 minutes. Then bake uncovered for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Stuffing
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: Night before:  Tear up bread and put it in a bowl on the counter. Mix it up a few times throughout so the bread becomes hard.  On Thanksgiving: Dice about 1/4 cup onion and 1/4 cup celery.  Saute with 1 tbsp of butter until soft. Add to bread crumbs. Sprinkle sage over bread crumbs.  Put enough on so it looks seasoned but not completely green!  Salt and pepper too! Add one beaten egg. Add some chicken broth. Just add a little at a time.Mix with your hands. You want it to be moist enough but not soaking. Stuff turkey - both sides. Put extra in foil or casserole dish.

recipes.name: Indian Casserole
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350ºF. Lightly spray a 9x13x2-inch pan with cooking spray. Melt 2 Tbsp of butter in large skillet over medium-high heat. Add zucchini, squash and onion. Sauté for 10 minutes, or until tender. Add garlic and cook and additional 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir together cooked zucchini, squash, onion, corn, white cheddar cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise, eggs, salt and pepper. Stir in ½ cup of breadcrumbs and ½ cup of parmesan cheese. Spread mixture into prepared pan. Melt remaining 2 Tbsp butter. Combine melted butter, remaining breadcrumbs and parmesan cheese. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake uncovered for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.name: Green Beans
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flake, or to taste
recipes.directions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add red pepper flake and stir to coat the pepper in the oil. Add green beans and cook, stirring often until the beans are blistering and browning in areas, 5 to 7 minutes. Add garlic and salt and cook, stirring constantly until the garlic is fragrant and browning, about 30 seconds. Add water and immediately cover with a well-fitting lid or sheet of aluminum foil. Steam the green beans, covered, until they are bright green and crisp tender, 1 to 2 minutes. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Honey Balsamic Brussel Sprouts
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: 1 lb Brussels sprouts trimmed and halved
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss the halved brussel sprouts with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread the Brussels sprouts in a single layer on a large baking sheet, ensuring they are not overcrowded. Roast for 20-25 minutes, tossing halfway through, until tender and the outer leaves are crispy and caramelized. Whisk together the balsamic vinegar and honey in a small bowl. Remove the sprouts from the oven, drizzle with the honey balsamic glaze, and toss to combine. Serve immediately. You can also air fry them at 375 for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Swenson Burger Sauces
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: 1 tablespoon white sugar (omit if using Miracle Whip)
recipes.directions: Combine all ingredients. Give at 1-2 hours to sit before eating.

recipes.name: BLT Sandwich Sauce
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Combine all ingredients.

recipes.name: Dad's Sauce
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: This makes a small pot. Preheat oven to 400°

recipes.name: Panera Kitchen Sink Cookies
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: 1 tsp baking soda dissolved in 1 tbsp water
8 ounces semi-sweet or milk chocolate, chopped
5 ounces (2 bags) Werther's soft caramels, each cut in half
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350ºF. In a large mixing bowl, melt the butter and coconut oil with the brown sugar in the microwave. Stir and let mixture sit for 5 minutes. Whisk in the egg, the egg yolk, and the vanilla. Add the flour, baking soda water, and salt. Mix just until dough forms. Fold in the chocolate and pretzel crumbs. Toss the caramel pieces in a little bit of flour to prevent clumping, and mix them into the dough as well. Scoop ¼ cup of dough and roll it into a ball. Try to tuck the caramel pieces inside the dough or keep them on top. Place 6 balls of dough on each baking pan, leaving plenty of room for spreading. Sprinkle generously with flaked sea salt. Bake for 9 minutes, and then let cool completely on the baking pan.

recipes.name: M & M Cookies
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350° In a large bowl, mix sugar, eggs, butter, Crisco, and vanilla thoroughly.  Add flour, salt, and baking soda to creamed mixture.  Blend well.  All ¾ cup of M ‘n M’s.  Drop dough by teaspoonful onto cookie sheet.  Slightly push a few candies on top of each dough ball with remaining candies.  Bake for 9-11 minutes, to your liking. Editor’s Note: Refrigerate dough 5 minutes before rolling.

recipes.name: Hershey's Double Chocolate Cookies
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350° In large bowl beat butter, sugar, eggs, and vanilla.  Stir together flour, cocoa, baking soda, and salt; add to butter mixture.  Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.  Drop by rounded tsp.  Bake 8-10 minutes.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: ¾ cup Brown Sugar, firmly packed
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350° In small bowl, combine flour, baking soda, and salt.  Set aside.  In a large bowl, combine butter, sugar, brown sugar, and vanilla extract.  Beat until creamy.  Beat in eggs.  Gradually add flour mixture.  Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.  Drop onto an ungreased cookie sheets.  Bake 9-11 minutes.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Cookies
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350°  In a large bowl, beat butter until light and fluffy.  Add granulated sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg.  Add eggs and vanilla; beat until combined.  Beat in pumpkin.  Add flour slowly until combined.  Dough will be very wet.  Drop dough by the tbsp. onto parchment lined sheets.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until tops are set.  Transfer cookies to wire rack; let cool.  For the frosting, beat all ingredients until soft and whipped.

recipes.name: Broccoli Casserole
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 1 Large Bunch Broccoli, 10 minutes cooked and drained
2 10 ounce cans Cream of Mushroom Soup
3 ounces Ritz Crackers, about 32 crackers, crushed
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350º.  Mix and put all non-topping ingredients into greased 13 by 9 inch pan.  Combine the crackers and butter.  Pour on top of mixture.  Bake for 35-45 minutes.

recipes.name: Amish Macaroni Salad
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 1 ½ Small Red Bell Peppers, seeded and chopped
¼ cup and 1 tsp. Prepared Yellow Mustard
1 tbsp. and ½ tsp. White Vinegar
recipes.directions: Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add macaroni, and cook for 8-10 minutes, until tender.  Drain, and set aside to cool.  In a large bowl, stir together the eggs, onion, celery, red pepper, and relish.  In a small bowl, stir together the mayo, miracle whip, mustard, sugar, vinegar, salt, and celery seed.  Pour over the vegetables, and stir in macaroni until well blended.  Cover and chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.name: Green Bean Casserole
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 2 cans Green Beans, thawed and drained
1 ½ cups French Fried Onions, divided
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350°  Mix all ingredients except for ½ cup french fried onions, in 1 ½ quart casserole dish.  Bake for 30 minutes.  Top with remaining onions.  Bake 5 minutes more or until onions are golden.

recipes.name: Ham & Hash Brown Casserole
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 2 cans Condensed Cram of Potato Soup
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 375°  Lightly grease a 9 by 13 inch baking dish.  In a large bowl, mix hash browns, ham, cream of potato soup, sour cream, and cheddar cheese.  Spread evenly into prepared dish.  Sprinkle with parmesan cheese.  Bake 1 hour or until bubbly and lightly brown.  Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Sticky Rice Noodles
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: Soak rice noodles in almost boiling water for 4 minutes, until al dente. Drain, then rinse with cold water. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large skilled, add green onions and garlic. Saute for 1-2 minutes. Add sugar and mix unitl incorporated. Add soy sauce and let simmer for 1 minute. Add noodles and continue to cook for 5-7 mintues until noodles have freid and absorbed the sauce. Garnish with additional green onion.

recipes.name: Air Fryer Asparagus
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: ½ teaspoon seasoned salt, or to taste
recipes.directions: Toss asparagus in ingredients. 400 for 7-10 minutes

recipes.name: Kielbasa & Veggie Sheet Pan
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 400 and cover roasting pan with parchment paper. Cut all ingredients and spead out on pan. Drizzle with olive oil and toss with spices. Bake for 30-45 minutes. Add cheese for garnish.

recipes.name: Ribs
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Instapot: Use the trivet. 1 cup of water, 1/2 cup BBQ. Cook 28 min on high pressure, natural release for 25 min.

recipes.name: Creamy Chicken and Pasta
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 1/2 cup White Wine or Chicken Broth
recipes.directions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, saute mushrooms and onions in butter for 4-5 minutes. Add wine or broth and garlic. Bring to boil; cook until liquid is reduced by half, about 5 minutes. Combine flour and water until smooth; gradually add to mushrom mixture. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Stir in cream. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 4-5 minutes. Drain pasta. Add pasta, chicken, salt, and pepper to cream sauce. Cook 3-4 minutes or until heated through. Sprinkle with parmesan.

recipes.name: Creamy Tomato Tortellini
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Heat olive oil in skillet. Add the roma tomatoes, cut side down. Cook 7-8 minutes, lid on, until the tomatoes soften and start to blister. Remove the skins with a fork. Mash gently with a spoon. Sprinkle with seasonings. Then, pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream. Bring to gentle simmer. Add tortellini and cook according to package directions. Stir in parmesan until creamy and well combined. Remove from heat and top with burrata. If it's too saucy, let it sit a little longer.

recipes.name: Lasagna
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350°  Brown ground beef, drain, add to spaghetti sauce, set aside.  Save some spaghetti sauce for top.  Mix Ricotta with eggs.  Boil Lasagna according to package.  Slightly cover bottom of casserole with meat sauce.  Then alternate layers: Lasagna, ricotta, lasagna, meat sauce sprinkled with mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  End with top layer of sauce and cheese.  Bake, covered, for 1 hour

recipes.name: White Cheese Chicken Lasagna
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 2 packages Frozen Chopped Spinach, thawed and drained
¼ cup Grated Parmesan Cheese (for topping)
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350° Cook noodles to package directions. Melt the butter in a large saucepan. Add onion and garlic. Stir in the flour and salt, and simmer until bubbly.  Mix in the broth and milk, and boil, stirring constantly, for 1 minute. Stir in 2 cups of mozzarella cheese and ¼ cup Parmesan cheese.  Season with the basil, oregano, and ground black pepper.  Remove from heat, and set aside.  Spread 1/3 of the sauce mixture in the bottom of a 9 by 13 inch baking dish.  Layer with 1/3 of the noodles, the ricotta, and the chicken.  Arrange 3 lasagna noodles over the chicken and layer with 1/3 of the sauce mixture, spinach, remaining 2 cups mozzarella, and 1/2 cup Parmesan. Arrange remaining noodles over cheese and spread remaining sauce evenly over noodles. Sprinkle with parsley and remaining 1/4 cup Parmesan. Bake 35-40 minutes.

recipes.name: Creamy Tuscan Sausage Pasta
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: Fresh basil leaves torn, for garnish
recipes.directions: Cook the penne pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, warm the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the sausage and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes. Set aside.  Reduce the heat to medium and add the garlic. Sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute, then stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, chicken broth, Italian seasoning, and red pepper flakes. Add the cream, bring to a simmer, and cook for 3-5 minutes to thicken. Stir in the Parmesan cheese, followed by the cooked sausage and baby spinach. Cook until the spinach is wilted, about 1-2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Add the cooked penne to the skillet and toss to coat in the sauce, adding some reserved pasta water if needed to thin the sauce.

recipes.name: Vodka Pasta
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: 1 tsp. red pepper flakes or to taste
1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan more to taste
optional garnishes: finely chopped parsley and red pepper flakes
recipes.directions: Cook pasta according to package directions. In a saucepan, add the olive oil over medium heat. Add the garlic and tomato paste and cook for about 4 to 5 minutes. The tomato paste will darken in color from a bright red to reddish brown. This process removes acidity from the tomato paste. Add heavy cream and mix until incorporated. Simmer for about 2 to 3 minutes. Add the red pepper flakes, dried basil, salt, and black pepper to taste. Mix again. Add the grated parmesan, butter, and 1/2 a cup pasta water. Mix until the sauce is smooth and creamy. If you think it needs more pasta water, you can add but 1/2 a cup is perfect for me. Toss in the cooked pasta and mix to coat evenly. Optional, top it off with more grated parm, chopped parsley, and chili flakes.

recipes.name: Olive Garden Alfredo
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: In a saucepan over medium heat, melt butter.  Add in garlic and cook for 2 minutes.  Add in cheese and mix until melted.  Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Salmon
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan. Season the salmon generously with salt. Cook the salmon for 3 minutes then turn and cook for a further 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Tuna Turnovers
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 425° Combine tuna and miracle whip.  Separate the crescent rolls into rectangles (2 triangles).  Spread tuna mixture on 1 half of the rectangle.  Put cheese over tuna mixture.  Fold over crescent rolls and seal dough.  Place on ungreased baking sheet.  Bake for about 10 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.name: Tilapia
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Preheat broiler.  Grease a broiling pan or line pan with aluminum foil.  In small bowl mix cheese, butter, mayonnaise, and lemon juice.  Add spices.  Arrange fillets on pan and broil a few inches from heat for 2-3 minutes.  Remove fillets and top with parmesan mixture.  Broil 2-3 more minutes.

recipes.name: Snickerdoodles
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Beat butter until smooth. Add in white sugar packed brown sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. In another bowl, mix together flour, baking soda, kosher salt, and cream of tartar. Gently beat the flour mixture into the butter mixture. Don't overdo it. Make cinnamon & sugar mix. Roll dough balls in cinnamon & sugar. Bake 9-11 minutes, until the edges are barely set. Let the cookies set up on the pan for at least 3-5 minutes. Remove the cookies to a wire cooling rack and let cool for a few minutes. While the cookies are still warm, but cool enough to handle (and not falling apart), place each cookie back into the bowl of cinnamon sugar.

recipes.name: Sugar Cookies
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups all purpose flour, spooned and leveled
1/4 cup granulated sugar, for smashing cookies
recipes.directions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl, beat butter for about 2 minutes. Make sure it is nice and smooth, light and fluffy. Add granulated sugar, powdered sugar, and vegetable oil. Beat until well combined. Add vanilla and eggs. Beat well until smooth. Add flour, baking soda, cream of tartar, and kosher salt. Beat the dry ingredients into the dough until just barely combined; don’t over mix.     Roll into 1 inch balls. The dough is pretty soft because of the oil, but fear not, they bake up just fine. Add 1/4 cup of granulated sugar to a plate. Lightly wet the bottom of a drinking glass that has a flat bottom. Dip the glass in the sugar and use it to smash one cookie dough ball. Dip in sugar again and repeat with the remaining dough. You want to smash the cookies so they are about 1/4 inch thick. Bake about 10-12 minutes. You want the edges of the cookie to be light brown, and there should be no shine in the center of the cookie. Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes on the pan, then remove to a cooling rack to cool completely. Use Royal Icing recipe.

recipes.name: Royal Icing
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: 2/3 cup water plus more for flood icing
recipes.directions: Combine ingredients in the bowl of a stand mixer. Mix on low speed with a whisk attachment until ingredients are combined. Turn up the speed to med/high and mix for 5 min or until very thick, shiny, stiff and white. You want the peaks of the icing to stand straight up without flopping over at all. If you want to make several different colors, divide the icing into several different bowls and beat in the food coloring by hand with a rubber spatula. For flood icing, add a bit more water at a time until you get the consistency you want- You want to be able to pull up a spoonful of icing and have it drip back down into the bowl and combine with the rest of the icing within just a few seconds.

recipes.name: Brownie Trifle
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 1 package Brownie Mix with Chocolate Chips
Chocolate Candy Bar, to shave and put on top
recipes.directions: Make brownies according to package directions.  Cool completely and cut into 1 inch squares.  Whip heavy cream with sugar and vanilla until stiff peaks form.  In a large bowl, combine pudding mix, water, and sweetened condensed milk.  Fold in half of the whipped cream.  In a trifle bowl, make a layer of brownies.  Spread 1/3 of the chocolate mixture on top of the brownies, and then 1/3 of the whipped cream on top of that.  Repeat the layers until you fill the bowl.  Top with the shaved chocolate.  Chill overnight.

recipes.name: Apple Cheesecake Bars
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: 3 cups finely chopped apples (3 large appled)
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 350°F and line a 9x13-inch baking dish with parchment paper. Add graham crackers to a food processor and reduce to crumbs. Add brown sugar, pecans, oats, salt, and butter and pulse a few times until pecans and oats and broken up a bit and mixture is uniform and sandy. Press half of streusel into the prepared sheet pan. Bake until lightly set, 8-9 minutes. Set aside to cool slightly. To make the cheesecake filling: Beat cream cheese and sugar with an electric mixer until smooth and creamy. Add eggs one at a time, followed by vanilla, scraping down the bowl as needed. Spoon cheesecake filling over the slightly cooked streusel crust. To make the cinnamon apples: Toss apples with sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle evenly over the cheesecake filling. Top with remaining streusel. Bake until filling is set and no longer jiggles when pan is shaken (some movement is good, do not over bake), about 45 minutes. Let bars cool on a wire rack for 30 minutes, then transfer to the fridge and chill for at least 1-2 hours before serving.

recipes.name: Cannoli Dip
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
recipes.directions: Beat together ricotta, cream cheese, and powdered sugar. Add in vanilla. Add more powdered sugar if needed, up to 1/2 cup. Mix in chocolate chips.

recipes.name: Pie Dough
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: For one single pie crust or 4-6 tart shells:
For one 8, 9, or 10 inch double crust or lattice-top pie two 8, 9, or 10 inch single crust pies or 6-8 tale tart shells:
recipes.directions: Sift flour and salt together; cut in shortening with pastry blender until pieces are the size of small peas. Add water, 1 tbsp. at a time.

recipes.name: Apple Pie Filling
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: 6-8 Tart Apples, pared, cored, and thinly sliced
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 400°  Combine sugar, flour, spices, and salt.  Mix with apples.  Line 9 inch pie plate with pastry.  Fill with mixture and dot with butter.  Cut slices only on top pie crust.  Bake for 50 minutes.

recipes.name: Cinnamon & Sugar Nutella Pastry Tree
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sugar mixed with 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
recipes.directions: Preheat oven to 400° and thaw pastry sheets. Cut pastry sheets into the shape of a tree. Spread nutella on one pastry sheet. Lay the second pasty sheet on top. Don't forget the stump and star! Cut 1 inch thick strips down the tree and twist. Brush with egg yolk. Bake 25 minutes. Brush with butter and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.

recipes.name: Perfectly Chocolate Chocolate Cake
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions:
Preheat oven to 350° Grease and flour two 9 in. round baking pans.
Combine dry ingredients in large bowl. Add eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla; beat on medium speed for 2 min. Stir in boiling water (batter will be thin) Pour into pans. Bake 30-35 min. Cool for 10 min.
Frost with Perfectly Chocolate Chocolate Frosting
Yield: 10-12 servings
Only bake for 20-25 min. for cupcakes.

recipes.name: Ice Cream Cake
recipes.author: Niki Marotta
ingredients: ¼-½ gallon Chocolate Ice Cream, slightly softened
¼-½ gallon Vanilla Ice Cream, slightly softened
recipes.directions: Combine 2 cups Oreos with butter and sugar. Press into 13 by 9 inch pan.  Freeze 15 minutes.  Spread layer of ice cream on top and freeze for 3 hours. Combine powdered sugar, chocolate chips, evaporated milk, and butter in saucepan and bring to a boil for 8 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in vanilla.  Cool to room temperature.  Spoon sauce on ice cream and freeze until firm.  Add other layer of ice cream and freeze. Spread cool whip on top and sprinkle with oreo crumbs.  Freeze for 3 hours. Note: If doing a brownie bottom, use 1 box and bake for 25 min in a 13x9

recipes.name: Chicken Gnocchi Soup
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
ingredients: 3-4 boneless skinless chicken breasts - cooked and diced
recipes.directions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add celery, onions, garlic, and carrots and saute for 2-3 minutes until onions are translucent. Add chicken, chicken broth, salt, pepper, and thyme, bring to a boil, then gently stir in gnocchi. Boil for 3-4 minutes longer before reducing heat to a simmer and cooking for 10 minutes. Stir in half and half, heavy whipping cream, and spinach and cook another 1-2 minutes until spinach is tender. Taste, add salt and pepper if needed, and serve.

recipes.name: Tomato Soup
recipes.author: Cassie Abood
recipes.directions: In a saucepan, combine tomato soup and 1 can full of milk of choice or heavy cream.Add garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper and let sit on medium-low heat for about 10 minutes. Pour into bowls and top with parmesan cheese and fresh basil.
